'''Amaran''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] who served [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Serjay Thul]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She relayed his pleas of help to fellow [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperials]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mistress Amaran appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where she gave Imperial players the bonus series for Alderaan. She, along with her Republic counterpart [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Collo]] and the [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] bonus series mission givers, were removed in Game Update 4.1.<ref name="Patch notes 4.1">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/282016/game-update-4.1-anarchy-paradise-patch-notes|text=Game Update 4.1: Anarchy in Paradise Patch Notes}}</ref>
